meta.title: Pricing and plans | doctorVet
meta.description: doctorVet's three plans for your veterinary clinic, Basic, Advanced and Super, and what each includes. Try every feature for 14 days with no card and no automatic renewal.

hero.title: Pay for what your clinic needs, after you've tried everything
hero.sub: Every plan includes medical records, vaccines, inpatient care and the full stock module. Plans differ in sales, money and client outreach: the POS, reports and payroll from Advanced; credit sales, delivery, the online store and campaigns in Super. The 14-day trial opens everything, no card needed.

basic.name: Basic
basic.for: For clinics that want records, vaccines and stock in one place, without selling through a POS.
highlights: A file for every animal: visits, exams, lab results, photos and X-rays
Vaccine schedule that asks when the next dose is due each time you give one
Inpatient care and surgery: hourly dose board, care sheet and cage room
Full pharmacy and stock: purchases, supplier ledger, expiry dates and counts
Appointments, plus online booking requests from owners' accounts that you confirm
Permissions for each staff member, an activity log, and printouts with your logo

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.for: For clinics that sell medicines and supplies directly and want to see their numbers every day.
highlights: POS: scan or search, split payment, A4 and thermal receipts
Line-by-line returns, quantity offers and bundles
The full reports hub, with Excel and print
Cash drawer count at the end of each shift, and expenses by category
Payroll, advances and loans in instalments, with printed payslips

super.name: Super
super.for: For clinics that sell on credit, deliver orders and follow up with clients on WhatsApp.
highlights: Credit sales and partial payments, with a statement for every client
Delivery by your own drivers or courier companies: collect from each driver, with a statement for each company
An online store on your clinic's own link, with cash on delivery
Reminders hub: the list of who's due builds itself, and each WhatsApp message is ready to send in one tap
WhatsApp campaigns by client group: vaccines due, birthdays, clients who stopped coming

trial.title: The free trial, and what happens after
items: 14 days with every feature of every plan, from the POS to the store and campaigns.
No card needed for the trial, and nothing is charged.
On day 15, if you haven't subscribed, the account pauses at the subscription screen until you pay for a plan.
Your data isn't deleted when the trial ends: subscribe and you carry on with it as it is.
No automatic renewal: you pay only for the period you choose. If a paid period ends and you don't renew, the account becomes read-only: you see your files and invoices but can't add new ones.

payment.title: Payment and renewal
payment.iraq: In Iraq, you pay in Iraqi dinar through Wayl, the Iraqi online payment gateway, for the period you choose: a month or a year.
payment.other: In {{country}}: online payment for clinics outside Iraq is being prepared, and the free trial is open to you now with every feature. If its 14 days end before payment is available, the account pauses at the subscription screen and your data isn't deleted.
payment.howTitle: How to pay from your country

roi.title: Run the numbers for your clinic
roi.sub: Every booster that misses its date is a visit that didn't happen. Enter your own numbers to see what that adds up to each month. On every plan, the system asks when the next dose is due each time you give one, and puts it on the calendar on its day.
roi.note: An estimate from your own numbers, not a promise. It counts booster fees only, and that is revenue, not profit.

items.q: Do I need a card to start the trial?
items.a: No. The trial runs for 14 days with every feature, and we don't ask for a card or any other payment method to start it.
Nothing is charged. If you choose a plan and pay, you carry on with the same data. If you don't subscribe, the account pauses at the subscription screen until you do, and your data isn't deleted.

items.q: Should I subscribe before the trial ends?
items.a: There's no need. A paid period starts on the day you pay and ends the trial, and the remaining trial days aren't added to it. If you pick a smaller plan, the features outside it close straight away. So we suggest paying in the last days of your trial.

No. Nothing is charged unless you pay yourself, for the period you choose: a month or a year. The days left are always shown in your account menu. If a period ends and you don't renew, the account becomes read-only: you can see your files and invoices but can't add new ones until you renew.

Switch the toggle above the plans to Annual: wherever a year costs less than 12 months, the card shows how much you save. Where no saving appears, the only difference is paying once instead of every month.

items.q: Are there fees per case or per animal?
items.a: No. You pay the plan price for the month or the year, with no fee per case, per animal or per WhatsApp message. Messages go out from the WhatsApp app on your own device, not through a paid messaging service.

Yes. When you pay for another plan you move to it right away, its period is added to what's left of your current one, and all those remaining days count on the new plan. That's why it makes sense to move to a smaller plan near the end of your period.

items.q: How do I pay if my clinic is outside Iraq?
items.a: Online payment works only from inside Iraq today, in dinar through Wayl. Payment from other countries is being prepared, and the trial is open to you now with every feature. If the trial ends before payment from your country is available, the account pauses at the subscription screen and your data isn't deleted.

final.title: Start with every feature, and choose your plan once you know what you need
final.sub: 14 days free, with no card and no automatic renewal. When you subscribe, you carry on with the same data.
